name: AGC 110482 (Hubble)
blurb: AGC 110482, a gas-rich dwarf galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: agc110482-hubble
story: AGC 110482 is one of the lowest-mass gas-rich galaxies that still hold stars. Hubble picked out its individual stars to measure its distance, and its gas turns slowly like a spinning wheel.

claims.text: AGC 110482 is a SHIELD galaxy: an extremely low-mass gas-rich dwarf discovered by the ALFALFA survey
Hubble imaging measured SHIELD galaxy distances from resolved stars (tip of the red giant branch)
AGC 110482 shows solid-body rotation in its gas
